# WIGTN Presentation

Create a presentation using the available presentation tooling or a self-contained HTML deck, according to the requested output format.

## Workflow

1. Establish audience, purpose, duration, output format, and language from context. Ask only when the format materially changes delivery.
2. Read [brand](references/brand.md) and [design guide](references/design-guide.md).
3. Build one narrative per slide, with concise copy, intentional hierarchy, and a consistent light or dark theme.
4. Apply the WIGTN logo and purple-dot signature consistently without turning every element purple.
5. Render or preview every slide. Check clipping, overflow, font substitution, contrast, and visual rhythm; iterate before delivery.
6. Return the artifact and a concise verification summary.

Do not apply WIGTN identity to a generic or third-party presentation without explicit user intent.
